complete_examples.text: When the height increases from −60 mm to 60 mm, the increase in gauge expansion reaches 235.00%, and there is a significant change in gauge expansion, only when the pad height is lowered or raised.

Overall, with different curve radii and support block height adjustments, all safety and stability indicators of train operation, as well as gauge expansion, are within the limits specified in the standard, and the track geometry has a good ability to maintain.
